instruction.text: Decide whether you know for sure if each stranger is nice or not.

feedback.finish: Even if strangers look nice, we can never be sure if they really are. When you can, it’s best to avoid talking to strangers.

trainers.instruction: Imagine you are talking to a stranger. What should you never tell them?

feedback.finish: These are all examples of personal information that should never be given out to strangers.

instruction.text: Decide what Sammy and Sun should do.

feedback.end: If a stranger is asking for your personal information, you should never answer - even if you think it would be rude not to answer!

atoms.a: Sammy and Sun are playing at the park while their mums sit on a bench and chat. A stranger approaches them and asks what school they go to.

b.sound: they should tell the stranger the name of their school to be polite
they should tell the lady that they won’t answer that question and go to tell their mums what happened

end.text: Sometimes strangers can lie about who they are to persuade you that they are safe. You should tell a trusted adult what is happening if someone you don’t know asks you to go somewhere with them.

atoms.a: Devi is waiting by the school gates for her dad to pick her up. A stranger approaches her and tells Devi that he is a friend of her dad’s and will drive her home.

b.sound: Devi should go with the man, since he said he knows her dad
Devi should go back into the school and find a teacher to tell them what happened
